name: docmind-sample-eval
description: SAMPLE / DEMO DATASET. Hand-written by the project author against three short fictional PDFs generated by evaluation/make_sample_docs.py. It exists to demonstrate and smoke-test the evaluation pipeline. It is tiny, and the author wrote both the documents and the queries, so scores on it are optimistic and do NOT indicate real-world retrieval or answer quality.

qa.question: How much can employees claim for home office furniture, and what is the deadline?
qa.reference_answer: A one-time home office allowance of 300 euros; claims must be submitted with receipts within sixty days of purchase.

qa.question: What are the eligibility requirements for remote work?
qa.reference_answer: Employees must complete a three-month probation period and have a satisfactory rating in their most recent performance review; roles requiring physical presence are not eligible.

qa.question: What caused the inverter outage and how long did it last?
qa.reference_answer: A failed cooling fan caused one of the four central inverters to shut down in July; it was replaced after eleven days under warranty.

qa.question: What is the usable battery capacity and its round-trip efficiency?
qa.reference_answer: The battery bank has a usable capacity of 2.4 megawatt-hours and a round-trip efficiency of 89 percent.

qa.question: What is the difference between L1 and L2 regularisation?
qa.reference_answer: L2 regularisation adds the sum of squared weights to the loss and discourages large weights; L1 adds the sum of absolute weights and tends to produce sparse models with many weights exactly zero.

qa.question: How is precision defined?
qa.reference_answer: Precision is the fraction of predicted positives that are actually positive, TP / (TP + FP).
